stem.text: Lithium reacts with nitrogen at room temperature to form solid $\text{Li}_3\text{N}$.
Three vessels of equal volume are connected by taps, A and B, as shown.

stem.alt: Three equal vessels joined by taps A and B: left vessel labelled evacuated, middle vessel containing the equilibrium N2(g) + 3H2(g) ⇌ 2NH3(g), right vessel containing lithium.

stem.text: At the start, A and B are closed, the left-hand vessel is evacuated, the middle vessel has the indicated reaction at equilibrium and the right-hand vessel contains lithium only.
Which action would allow the equilibrium mixture to contain the **most** ammonia?

A.text: Keep both A and B closed.
